RESOLUTION VERIFIED — all three live ACs confirmed on 2026-08-15 (~14:20 PT):

AC1 — live projects.json restored to canonical. `git show origin/tickets:.bridge_state/projects.json` = {"legacy_default":"REB","projects":{},"version":1}. Confirmed STILL canonical after the tickets branch advanced through all the A–G remediation ticket events (no re-corruption; the LEG/ONE/TWO/ZERO rehearsal keys are gone). Fix commit was 80f497e229.

AC2 — a live `rebar bridge preview` against REB (JIRA_PROJECT=REB, live creds) completed EXIT 0 with NO JQL parse error. The previously-crashing inbound fan-out now parses: it fetched from live Jira and produced a full clean diff — RECON: outbound_differ total=61 create=4 update=57 delete=0; inbound_differ total=3; bidir_suppressed inbound=19. The 'failed to parse JQL query: the value ... does not exist for the field project' error is gone (empty projects:{} → fan-out falls back to [REB], and post-C the predicate is statusCategory != Done).

AC3 — the next (and subsequent) scheduled Reconcile Bridge runs complete green. The last 6 scheduled runs are all completed/success: 31906924704 (20:31Z), 31904063417 (19:29Z), 31901435085 (18:33Z), 31898479872 (17:30Z), 31895775813 (16:32Z), 31892903176 (15:30Z). No JQL crash in any.

The production outage is fully resolved and the code hardening that prevents recurrence landed as the seven A–G tickets (see prior comment). Closing.
